content: MS Majlis-i Sinā 316 (copied 12 Rabīʿ I 905/17 October 1499; colophon suggests a substantial part was done on 7 Shaʿbān 878/28 December 1473, and names Qivām al-Dīn Muḥammad Yazdī Ṣāʾinī as compiler with a copy date of 5 Rabīʿ I 849/11 June 1445) is a hybrid collection whose first element, the Munshaʾāt-i Ṣāʾin-i Turka (pp. 1-34), contains 45 letters, letter openings or notes from Ibn Turka. MK could see it only in an incomplete, partly illegible microfilm.
